data: Is the smoothed distance value at 200 degrees greater for oxidation than bass?

The question asks whether the smoothed distance value at 200 degrees is greater for oxidation than bass. From the caption, we know that the top panel represents bass and the bottom panel represents oxidation. By examining the graphs, we can see that at 200 degrees, the peak of the oxidation curve is higher than the peak of the bass curve. Therefore, the smoothed distance value at 200 degrees is indeed greater for oxidation than bass.
